propositions: A class with an unreachable model (local endpoint down or provider throttled) fails the gate; the feature enables fallback to alternative model configurations without manual retry logic.
FallbackModel is constructed from inline model configs in the fallback array, with fallback_on predicate set to _RETRYABLE | CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL to avoid masking credential or input-size errors.
Fallback entries preserve endpoint configuration and are built through the same provider path as the primary; clients are registered once per ProviderSession and closed exactly once on teardown.

Model capabilities are computed from the intersection of all candidates (primary + fallbacks) before the wrapper exists, ensuring temperature or other constraints do not vary depending on which model answers.
ran_model is read from ModelResponse.model_name (the actual answering model), not FallbackModel.model_name (a synthetic string), so verdicts correctly attest the model that ran.

FallbackModel must be entered as an async context manager so pydantic-ai's own provider clients are opened and closed; rebar-created clients remain on ProviderSession._closeables to avoid double-close.
